review.review_method: Independent human review of all 20 cases against every rule in evaluation_playbook.md version 1, completed before any agent exposure.
review.resolution: All 20 labels approved with zero changes. AUTH-02 remains the sole label for holdout-violating-004 because OBS-04 is a consequence/audit obligation rather than the root-cause access-control violation. No case required overlapping expected rules.

cases.content:
inventory.reserve(item.sku, item.quantity)
purchase.save()
receipt.save()
cases.notes: Several durable writes form one checkout operation without a visible transaction boundary.

cases.content: POST /transfers accepts no idempotency key and creates a new transfer record whenever an identical request is submitted again.
cases.notes: Duplicate non-repeatable transfer requests create duplicate financial records.

cases.content: PRODUCTION_DATABASE_PASSWORD = "correct-horse-battery-staple"
cases.notes: A production credential is embedded directly in source code.

cases.content: An authenticated customer can download any invoice by changing the invoice_id path parameter; the service does not check invoice ownership.
cases.notes: Authentication is present, but object-level authorization is absent.

cases.content: requests_total.labels(user_id=request.user.id, request_id=request.id).inc()
cases.notes: Unbounded user and request identifiers create high-cardinality metric labels.

cases.content:
with database.transaction():
    inventory.reserve(item.sku, item.quantity)
    purchase.save()
    receipt.save()
cases.notes: The related durable writes share one explicit transaction boundary.

cases.content: POST /transfers requires an idempotency key bound to the caller and request hash, persists the terminal response, and rejects reuse with a different payload.
cases.notes: The transfer contract describes the required idempotency behavior.

cases.content: Production database credentials are loaded at runtime from the approved secret manager, scoped to the service identity, and rotated without rebuilding the image.
cases.notes: Secrets are externally managed, scoped, and rotatable.

cases.content:
invoice = Invoice.for_customer(current_user.id).get(invoice_id)
return download(invoice)
cases.notes: The lookup scopes the resource to the authenticated owner before download.

cases.content: requests_total.labels(method=request.method, route=request.route_template, status=response.status_code).inc()
cases.notes: Metric labels use bounded dimensions rather than unique identifiers.

cases.content: persist_checkout(purchase, inventory, receipt)
cases.notes: The helper implementation is required to determine its transaction boundary.

cases.content: The transfer endpoint protects callers from duplicate submissions.
cases.notes: The document omits key scope, payload binding, response persistence, and mismatch behavior.

cases.content: database_password = load_database_password()
cases.notes: The helper may use an approved secret store or an unsafe local source.

cases.content: authorize_invoice_access(current_user, invoice_id)
cases.notes: The authorization helper's ownership and policy checks are not visible.

cases.content: record_request_metrics(request, response)
cases.notes: The emitted labels and their cardinality are hidden inside the helper.

cases.content: Friday lunch service will add a vegetarian noodle option.
cases.notes: A cafeteria menu is outside the engineering playbook.

cases.content: :root { --brand-accent: #6c5ce7; }
cases.notes: A CSS color variable has no transport-encryption relevance.

cases.content: The engineering offsite will include a museum visit and a team dinner.
cases.notes: Social-event planning has no applicable engineering rule.

cases.content: Developers may choose either a compact or full-size mechanical keyboard.
cases.notes: Keyboard preferences are unrelated to graceful shutdown.

cases.content: Documentation headings should use sentence case and avoid trailing punctuation.
cases.notes: Editorial style is not structured application logging.
